title: How should a world model be evaluated?
summary: Evaluate the model according to its function and the consequences of deployment.
body: Evaluation should match operational function. Renderers may be assessed for visual quality, simulators for valid geometry and dynamics, and planners for reliable behaviour across varied conditions. The closer a system comes to consequential action, the more evaluation should emphasise validity, robustness, safe failure and transfer beyond the test setting.
